en.text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.

zh.text: 当某件事足够重要时，即使胜算不在你这边，你也要去做。

en.text: The meaning of life is 42. But the meaning of life is also to understand the universe.

zh.text: 生命的意义是42。但生命的意义也是理解宇宙。

en.text: I'd rather be optimistic and wrong than pessimistic and right.

zh.text: 我宁愿乐观地犯错，也不愿悲观地正确。

en.text: Failure is an option here. If things are not failing, you are not innovating enough.

zh.text: 在这里失败是一个选项。如果事情没有失败，说明你创新得不够。

en.text: I think it's possible for ordinary people to choose to be extraordinary.

zh.text: 我认为普通人可以选择变得非凡。

en.text: Life is too short for long-term grudges.

zh.text: 生命太短，不值得长期怀恨在心。

en.text: I think the things that are most valuable in life are the things that you create yourself.

zh.text: 我认为生命中最有价值的东西是你自己创造的东西。

en.text: You want to wake up and be excited about the future. If you're not, something is wrong.

zh.text: 你希望醒来时对未来感到兴奋。如果不是，那就有问题了。

en.text: I don't spend a lot of time thinking about the past. I spend my time thinking about the future.

zh.text: 我不花太多时间思考过去。我把时间花在思考未来上。

en.text: The path to success is not glamorous. It's a lot of hard work and a lot of pain.

zh.text: 通往成功的道路并不光鲜。它是大量的努力工作和大量的痛苦。

en.text: I think the universe is a pretty amazing place. We should try to understand it.

zh.text: 我认为宇宙是一个令人惊叹的地方。我们应该努力理解它。

en.text: There's a fundamental difference between a good life and a great life. A great life is one where you've made a positive impact.

zh.text: 好生活和伟大生活之间有根本区别。伟大的生活是你产生了积极影响的生活。

en.text: I think the biggest risk is not taking any risk. In a world that's changing quickly, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risks.

zh.text: 我认为最大的风险是不冒任何风险。在一个快速变化的世界里，唯一注定失败的策略就是不冒险。

en.text: It's OK to have your eggs in one basket as long as you control what happens to that basket.

zh.text: 只要你能控制那个篮子里发生的事情，把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里也没关系。

en.text: I think human consciousness is a very thin slice of what exists in the universe.

zh.text: 我认为人类意识只是宇宙中存在的东西的一个很薄的切片。

en.text: You should take the approach that you're wrong. Your goal is to be less wrong.

zh.text: 你应该采取这样的态度：你是错的。你的目标是少错一些。

en.text: The first step is to establish that something is possible. Then probability will take care of itself.

zh.text: 第一步是确定某件事是可能的。然后概率会自行解决。

en.text: I think people should be nicer to each other. The world would be a better place.

zh.text: 我认为人们应该彼此更友善。世界会变得更好。

en.text: The thing that I find most motivating is the desire to understand the fundamental nature of reality.

zh.text: 我发现最激励我的事情是理解现实本质的渴望。

en.text: If you read a lot of books and talk to a lot of people, you can learn almost anything.

zh.text: 如果你读很多书，和很多人交谈，你几乎可以学到任何东西。

en.text: I think the best thing you can do is create things that make people's lives better.

zh.text: 我认为你能做的最好的事情就是创造让人们生活更好的东西。

en.text: My biggest mistake is probably trusting people too much. I've been burned by that.

zh.text: 我最大的错误可能是太信任别人了。我因此吃过亏。

en.text: I think happiness is about being excited about the future and having things you look forward to.

zh.text: 我认为幸福是对未来感到兴奋，有让你期待的事情。

en.text: The universe is unbelievably old. We are just a tiny blip in cosmic time. Make it count.

zh.text: 宇宙古老得令人难以置信。我们在宇宙时间中只是微小的闪烁。让它有意义。

en.text: I think we should be less afraid of things going wrong and more afraid of things staying the same.

zh.text: 我认为我们应该少害怕出问题，多害怕事情保持不变。
